en.description:
A standalone Apple Watch app that does not rely on an iPhone— the entire game can be played directly on the watch. It is specially designed for the Watch’s screen and interaction model, fully leveraging the Digital Crown and the haptic engine to deliver a Watch-exclusive experience.

I. Digital Crown Controls: Watch-Exclusive Gameplay
Rotate the Digital Crown to switch lanes between the left, center, and right lanes: rotate left to move into the left lane, rotate right to move into the right lane.

Lane switching has a brief cooldown to prevent accidental inputs, making the control rhythm clearer and more deliberate.
This is the core control method designed specifically for the Watch and cannot be replicated on phones or other platforms.

II. Watch-Exclusive Haptic Feedback
Key moments—such as firing bullets, picking up coins, destroying enemy vehicles, and failing due to collisions—each trigger distinct haptic feedback.
The feedback maps directly to in-game events, giving interactions on the small screen a stronger sense of “feel” and immersion.
The haptic design fully utilizes the Apple Watch Taptic Engine and is a critical part of the overall experience.

III. Other Features
Tap the screen to fire bullets and destroy enemy vehicles, avoid collisions, collect coins, and set new distance records.
Manage tank and bullet skins, view statistics, and access help directly on the watch—everything can be done entirely on the Watch.
en.subtitle: Race using the Digital Crown

zh.trackName: 赛车冲冲冲 For Watch手表游戏公路驾驶汽车跑跑经典版
zh.description:
手表独立应用，不依赖 iPhone，在手表上即可完整游玩。 针对 Watch 的屏幕与交互做了专门设计，充分利用 Digital Crown（数码表冠）与触觉引擎，提供 Watch 独有体验。

一、表冠操作：Watch 独有玩法 
1.通过旋转 Digital Crown 在左、中、右三条车道间换道，左转进入左道，右转进入右道。 
2.换道有短时冷却，避免误触，操作节奏更清晰。
3. 这是为手表设计的核心操作方式，在手机或其他平台上无法复现。

二、Watch 专有触觉反馈 
1.发射子弹、拾取金币、击毁敌车、碰撞失败等关键时刻，都会触发不同的触觉反馈。 •
2.反馈与游戏事件一一对应，让在小屏幕上的操作更有“手感”，更易沉浸。 
3. 触觉设计充分利用 Apple Watch 的 Taptic Engine，是本应用体验的重要组成部分。

三、其他特性 
1.点击屏幕发射子弹击毁敌车，躲避碰撞、收集金币、刷新最远距离。 
2.支持在手表上单独管理坦克与子弹皮肤、查看统计与帮助，所有功能在 Watch 上即可完成
